## What you did
- Set up the prod PG15→17 cutover as RDS blue/green, fixing the read replica to follow the blue/green instead of being destroyed and recreated, so the dashboards keep their read path [1].
- Wrote `runbooks/pg17-cutover.md` and opened PR #321 for Maya's review [1][3].
- Rehearsed the full sequence on a prod snapshot clone: green ready in 52 min, 74 s of write unavailability, no row-count mismatches on the biggest tables — then tore the clone down to stop the cost [1].

## What changed
- The window moves to **Sunday 22/11, 02:00–04:00 UTC**: Fernhill's month-end batch runs Saturday night until ~06:00, Maya confirmed with Sam, told the CSMs, and says you can update the runbook and merge [8][10].
- Maya approved #321 — Terraform looked right, she flagged your replica fix as a good catch — having only held the merge until the date was locked, which it now is [3].
- Daniel covers the API on call that night and asks to be pinged when you start the switchover [7].
- Lior needs 30 min notice before switchover so he can pause the ingest consumers cleanly [9].

## What is still open
- Rehearse the rollback on a fresh clone Thursday 19/11: it isn't a simple switch back, since blue is renamed after the swap and diverges immediately [1].
- Update the runbook to the new window and merge #321 [8].
